data.pool_rule: every TextVQA shard-0 row: image RGB resized to 224x224 (bicubic), Qwen2VLImageProcessorPil (224*224 pixels); chat template with one image and the question, <|image_pad|> expanded to grid.prod() // merge**2; target = prompt + most common answer + <|im_end|>; labels on the answer and <|im_end|> only; right padded to seq_len; mm_token_type_ids = 1 at image tokens; longer rows skipped
data.rule: data order o, batch i: epoch e = i // (n // B) is torch.randperm(n) under the seed of '<model>/order<o>/epoch<e>'; the batch is its rows [(i mod (n // B)) * B, +B)

order.rule: data order o, batch i: epoch e = i // (n // B) is torch.randperm(n) under the seed of '<model>/order<o>/epoch<e>'; the batch is its rows [(i mod (n // B)) * B, +B)

not_bound: attention, 2-D RoPE and multimodal RoPE as primitives (bound inside the Level-2 attention boundaries only)
